description: This file defines Arabic (Tunisia) cultural information and date parsing/formatting utilities for the DateJS library, including culture-specific date and time patterns, regex patterns, timezone info, and helper functions.

classes.name: Date.CultureInfo
classes.description: Object holding culture-specific date and time patterns, names, regex patterns, and timezone info for Arabic (Tunisia).

methods.name: Date._parse
methods.description: Main date parsing function that interprets date strings based on culture-specific formats.

methods.name: Date.parseExact
methods.description: Parses a date string with an exact expected format.
